name: Easy Cheesy Potato, Ham & Broccoli Casserole

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in a microwave safe bowl or a small saucepan. Transfer to a large bowl.
Wash and dry broccoli. Add to the bowl with the melted butter.

Medium dice ham. Add to the bowl along with diced potatoes, soup, sour cream, and 1 cup of the cheese. Stir to combine, transfer to a large baking dish, and spread out in an even layer. Sprinkle casserole with the remaining cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 oz ham steak, boneless
1 (32 oz) bag diced potatoes, frozen
1 (10.5 oz) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 cup sour cream
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Place casserole in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cooked through and cheese is golden and bubbly, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls and enjoy!
